definition.writer: domain mutation path/write endpoint/writer operation/transaction contract
definition.not_equivalent_to: whole process, Viewer application, or scheduled-task process
definition.phase1_scope: static operation-level ratchet; no cutover-unit ownership assignment

documented_exceptions.reason: Stage 3 needs one bounded read-only connection to inspect transition-era SQLite schemas. The connection requires URI mode=ro, immutable=1 and query_only, and the generated row-level audit remains outside Git.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all production cutover units have left SQLite and the transition schema auditor is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The Stage 3 read-only schema auditor recognizes PRAGMA dependencies and uses query_only, user_version and table_info for transition schema evidence; it does not execute mutating PRAGMAs.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all production cutover units have left SQLite and the transition schema auditor is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: Stage 4 freezes company, industry and theme legacy-to-stable identities through one bounded URI mode=ro connection to the transition-era research database; the tool never mutates SQLite and its row-level output remains outside Git.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after shared_identity is authoritative in PostgreSQL and the transition mapping bridge is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The read-only identity freezer uses one query_only guard plus bounded table, application, schema and user-version metadata inspection to bind one transaction-consistent schema/content snapshot; it does not execute mutating PRAGMAs.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after shared_identity is authoritative in PostgreSQL and the transition mapping bridge is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The Stage 4 cross-check opens one transaction-consistent, URI mode=ro research snapshot to compare frozen identities with legacy company/security facts; it never mutates SQLite and row-level evidence remains outside Git.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after shared_identity is authoritative in PostgreSQL and the transition cross-check is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The read-only cross-check applies query_only and reads bounded SQLite schema metadata before comparing source identities; no mutating PRAGMA is allowed.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after shared_identity is authoritative in PostgreSQL and the transition cross-check is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The nine-unit preparation tool opens each of the four transition SQLite sources through bounded URI mode=ro connections to create consistent source snapshots and reconciliation manifests; it never writes live SQLite.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all registered cutover units leave SQLite and source snapshot preparation is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The source snapshotter uses only query_only, schema-version and bounded table metadata PRAGMAs to bind a transaction-consistent migration baseline; mutating PRAGMAs are prohibited.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all registered cutover units leave SQLite and source snapshot preparation is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The static ratchet recognizes PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT statements in the S1 staging loader as SQLite-shaped syntax. These statements execute only through psycopg against PostgreSQL migration tables and never open or mutate SQLite.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when the SQLite-specific ratchet can distinguish PostgreSQL dialect context or the transition loader is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The static ratchet recognizes PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT statements used to promote the reconciled shared-identity staging snapshot as SQLite-shaped syntax. They execute only through psycopg in one PostgreSQL transaction and never connect to or mutate live SQLite.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when the SQLite-specific ratchet can distinguish PostgreSQL dialect context or the transition S1 promoter is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: During the bounded mixed-migration compatibility window, PostgreSQL-authoritative identity rows are materialized into one process-memory SQLite database so existing legacy SELECTs can use unchanged table names. The explicit environment reader opens the legacy identity file only while the authority matrix still declares SQLite and otherwise returns that PostgreSQL-derived cache. S3/S4 failures never read or mutate the frozen SQLite identity baseline.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when all shared-identity readers use the native PostgreSQL repository and the in-memory legacy read adapter is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The adapter attaches only its PostgreSQL-derived process-memory cache and shadows legacy identity table names with TEMP views; it never attaches or reads the frozen SQLite identity baseline. Any PostgreSQL authority or refresh failure is fail-closed with no fallback.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when all shared-identity readers use the native PostgreSQL repository and the in-memory legacy read adapter is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The PRAGMAs make the PostgreSQL-derived process-memory cache or pre-cutover legacy read connection query-only. They do not mutate a live SQLite database, and PostgreSQL authority never falls back to the legacy path.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when all shared-identity readers use the native PostgreSQL repository and the in-memory legacy read adapter is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The bounded compatibility adapter builds process-memory SQLite tables solely from PostgreSQL-authoritative financial rows and shared-identity mappings so existing read-only financial queries can run unchanged. It never opens or falls back to the frozen financial.db baseline.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all financial readers use native PostgreSQL repositories and the process-memory compatibility cache is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The adapter uses bounded process-memory SQLite schema inspection and query-only enforcement after materializing PostgreSQL rows; it does not inspect or mutate live SQLite files.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all financial readers use native PostgreSQL repositories and the process-memory compatibility cache is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The common adapter either opens the currently authoritative transition SQLite database under the authority matrix, or constructs a bounded process-memory SQLite compatibility surface from PostgreSQL-authoritative rows. PostgreSQL S3/S4 failures are fail-closed and never reopen the legacy SQLite file.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when all remaining production readers and writers use native PostgreSQL repositories and the process-memory transition adapter is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The adapter attaches only PostgreSQL-derived process-memory dependency projections and shadows reviewed legacy table names with TEMP views. Attached dependency views remain read-only and never attach a frozen production SQLite baseline after PostgreSQL authority is active.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when cross-unit readers use native PostgreSQL joins/repositories and no process-memory dependency projection remains.

documented_exceptions.reason: The adapter uses only query_only and foreign-key PRAGMAs on the selected transition connection or private process-memory compatibility database. It never uses mutating PRAGMAs against live SQLite and authority routing remains fail-closed.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when the common SQLite-shaped transition adapter is retired after native PostgreSQL repository adoption.

documented_exceptions.reason: The sentiment domain exceeds the reviewed process-memory limit, so its S3 transition adapter builds and opens a disposable runtime SQLite projection exclusively from PostgreSQL-authoritative records. It never opens the retired live sentiment.db and PostgreSQL failures remain fail-closed.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when sentiment readers and writers use native PostgreSQL repositories and no SQLite-shaped runtime projection remains.

documented_exceptions.reason: The disposable cache uses bounded WAL, durability, foreign-key, read-only and integrity PRAGMAs only on the PostgreSQL-derived runtime projection; no PRAGMA targets the retired live sentiment database.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove with the persistent transition projection after native PostgreSQL repository adoption.

documented_exceptions.reason: One bounded BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes application of the authoritative PostgreSQL overlay into the disposable local cache while a cross-process lock is held; it is not a live SQLite authority transaction.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove with the persistent transition projection after native PostgreSQL repository adoption.

documented_exceptions.reason: Conflict clauses maintain cache metadata and PostgreSQL-derived rows idempotently inside the disposable projection. Formal mutation idempotency remains enforced independently by PostgreSQL operation identity and revision checks.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove with the persistent transition projection after native PostgreSQL repository adoption.

documented_exceptions.reason: The persistent projection exposes one reviewed dependency method and one URI-mode read-only database attachment, both targeting the disposable PostgreSQL-derived cache. It never attaches the retired sentiment or research SQLite authority files.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when cross-unit dependencies use native PostgreSQL joins and the transition projection is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The static ratchet recognizes PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT statements in the financial S1 promoter as SQLite-shaped syntax. They execute only through psycopg against PostgreSQL and never open or mutate financial.db.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when the ratchet distinguishes PostgreSQL dialect context or the transition S1 promoter is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: The static ratchet recognizes PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT statements used for S1 mapping/backfill as SQLite-shaped syntax. They execute only in the PostgreSQL transaction and do not connect to live SQLite.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when the SQLite-specific ratchet can distinguish PostgreSQL dialect context or the transition S1 loader is retired.

documented_exceptions.domain: Stage 4 user-content final SQLite writer fence
documented_exceptions.reason: The approved first-unit cutover captures the final analyst_note watermark through one URI mode=ro connection before and after stopping the legacy Viewer. It executes query_only and rolls the explicit read transaction back; it never mutates SQLite.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after user_content_notes reaches durable S4 and the transition writer-fence capture is retired.

documented_exceptions.domain: Stage 4 user-content final SQLite writer fence
documented_exceptions.reason: The final watermark reads only query_only, table_info, schema_version, user_version and quick_check inside the bounded read transaction; no mutating PRAGMA is permitted.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after user_content_notes reaches durable S4 and the transition writer-fence capture is retired.

documented_exceptions.reason: 阶段 1 将既有、受测试的硅片 reviewer 从被排除的 cache 迁入正式源代码；该事务语义不是新业务写路径，保留用于一次性原子记录七类 review。
Phase 2 creates only synthetic SQLite fixtures outside live roots so clean-clone release and Viewer tests never touch production databases.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when the PostgreSQL dev/test fixture is authoritative in a later approved phase.

documented_exceptions.reason: Phase 2 release preflight opens transition-era SQLite files strictly read-only to fingerprint schemas and verify rollback compatibility.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all production cutover units use PostgreSQL compatibility inspection.

documented_exceptions.reason: Read-only query_only, user_version and object-column metadata PRAGMAs enforce the Phase 2 declared compatibility slice without mutating transition databases.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove after all production cutover units use PostgreSQL compatibility inspection.

documented_exceptions.reason: Phase 2 representative smoke discovers existing industry, company, PDF and Opportunity Lens identities through one explicit SQLite mode=ro connection helper; it never mutates live databases.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Replace with the approved data-access layer when the relevant cutover units leave SQLite.

documented_exceptions.reason: The route discovery helper enforces query_only in addition to SQLite URI mode=ro before selecting smoke identities.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Replace with the approved data-access layer when the relevant cutover units leave SQLite.

documented_exceptions.reason: One bounded direct connection selects SQLite URI read-only mode for the Phase 2 candidate so GET validation cannot create WAL or change live data.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when Viewer readers use the approved data-access layer in a later phase.

documented_exceptions.reason: Two bounded query_only PRAGMAs enforce read-only behavior for research and sentiment candidate connections; existing live-mode PRAGMAs remain legacy baseline.
documented_exceptions.sunset_condition: Remove when Viewer readers use the approved data-access layer in a later phase.
